title: fix: modified files with umlauts
summary: Incremental build detection now correctly handles project and app paths containing special characters like umlauts and German characters by disabling git escaping and setting UTF-8 encoding.
key_points: Git diff output is no longer escaped when detecting modified files
UTF-8 encoding is applied before running git commands to handle special characters correctly
Fixes incremental builds failing when paths contain umlauts or characters like ß
Added tests to verify the fix works across different character sets
The core.quotepath=false flag is added to git configuration
